    try {
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chatStream(req)

}
